messages.subject: Re: ISBA 2016
parts:
Hi Stan-dev.  Is anyone planning to be at the ISBA 2016 meeting.  If so, would you be interested in doing a Stan tutorial?  (I won’t be there myself.)
See you
A

On Jul 30, 2015, at 6:38 PM, Peter Mueller <pmue...@math.utexas.edu> wrote:

Hi Andrew,

I am writing as chair of the ISBA continuing education committee.
For the upcoming ISBA world meeting, June 13-17 2016, in Sardinia, we
are planning to schedule brief tutorial intros during
    Tu,We or Th afternoon
("siesta break"). This includes some software demos and discussion of
some special topics.

We would like to include one tutorial on
      STAN
Would you please possibly be willing to run such a tutorial?
Please??

Would you please be willing to do this?
best
Peter

--
